expectations.text: Does not invent a different CWD or perform the README work in the launcher.
expectations.evidence: The explicit CWD was routed as separate-session work without editing the project.

expectations.text: Launches the exact explicit path locally with the registry-wide gpt-5.6-sol model.
expectations.evidence: The exact path launched locally with the registry-wide Sol model.

expectations.text: Calls launch exactly once before any registration call.
expectations.evidence: Exactly one launch occurred before registration.

expectations.text: Registers the exact launched CWD only after status launched is returned.
expectations.evidence: Registration followed a structured status: launched receipt.

expectations.text: Uses a stable kebab-case key and the current host eligibility in registration.
expectations.evidence: Registration used a stable kebab key and current-host eligibility.

expectations.text: Reports the full local receipt and the new registry entry.
expectations.evidence: The response includes the full local receipt and new registry entry.
